title: Electrical after-effects of the encounter

tellings.quote: my phone even after factory resetting it, it would charge instantly for the first few days.

plain: After an encounter he says he had in 2019, the researcher Deep Prasad noticed something odd: his phone charged instantly for the first few days, even after he factory reset it. Prasad tells this himself on the show, as one of the physical after-effects that, to him, show the encounter left a real trace.
